task: [.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml] .github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml iş akışındaki 136 saniyelik medyan darboğazı gidermek için pip ve apt bağımlılık kurma adımlarına `actions/cache` entegrasyonu yapılarak tekrarlı paket indirmeleri engellenmeli, dokümantasyon veya ilgisiz dosya değişikliklerinde iş akışının çalışmaması için `paths` / `paths-ignore` filtreleri tanımlanmalı ve sıralı çalışan bağımsız test adımları ayrı job'lara bölünerek paralel yürütülecek şekilde yapılandırılmalıdır.

evidence.details: Target workflow identified for performance optimization targeting the 136-second median bottleneck via dependency caching, path filtering, and job parallelization.

factual_findings: The workflow `.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml` lacks `actions/cache` integration for pip and apt dependencies, leading to redundant downloads on every workflow execution.
The workflow triggers on changes without `paths` or `paths-ignore` filters, causing unnecessary executions for documentation and non-code updates.
Independent test steps are configured to run sequentially within a single job rather than executing concurrently across separate jobs.
hypotheses: Integrating `actions/cache` (or using `actions/setup-python` built-in pip caching and caching apt archives) will eliminate redundant download overhead.
Defining `paths-ignore` filters for non-code files (e.g., `**.md`, `docs/**`) will prevent invalid/unnecessary workflow triggers.
Splitting sequential test steps into separate parallel jobs will decrease total workflow duration below the 136-second median baseline.
result.recommendation: Refactor `.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml` to include `paths-ignore` on triggers, add `actions/cache` for pip and apt packages, and split monolithic test steps into distinct parallel jobs.
result.next_action: Apply the workflow refactoring to `.github/workflows/auto-merge-gate.yml` and verify parallel job execution and caching behavior.
